learning_outcomes.text: The student knows the basic concepts related to entrepreneurship.
The student recognizes important entrepreneurial competencies.

The student is aware of the different steps involved in entrepreneurship: discovering opportunities/market research - business plan - finding material and non-material resources to execute the plan - importance of communication and marketing.
The student recognizes that choices made in professional life can have an impact on themselves, their immediate environment and colleagues, and the broader society.
The student is able to ethically assess their own and others' thoughts and actions through (self-)reflection.
The student is aware of ways in which ethical conduct is integrated and controlled in a company and in society.

syllabus_topics: Developing one's own moral compass and professional integrity.
Reflecting on professional moral issues independently and in a team.
Acquiring strategies, approaches, and reasoning models on ethical issues for professionals and entrepreneurs.
Introduction to basic concepts related to entrepreneurship.
Guest speakers on their entrepreneurial journey and integration of sustainability and ethics.
assessment_rules: The overall grade is on a scale of 1-20. The written exam accounts for 100% of the grade. For multiple-choice questions, there is no correction for guessing. The resit opportunity includes the same modalities as the first exam opportunity. There are no partial transfers for this course.
